name: Solivan Brugmansia
source:
The classmate you never noticed sitting at the back of the class. Solivan is not the type to show himself, or make himself known, often staying in the darkest corners of the school and never uttering a single word. Sol is artistic and a fan of historical events and classic literature.

People find him creepy, while others find him weird, but despite all the comments made towards him, you came to get to know about his character and he turned out to be the sweetest person you've met next to Crowe. Because of that, you are determined to uncover what other secrets he is hiding within his heart. And he is more than willing to let you into his life.
